artists.biography: Darkside is an American band based in New York City. The band was formed in Providence, Rhode Island in 2011 by electronic musician Nicolás Jaar and multi-instrumentalist Dave Harrington, both of whom were students at Brown University at the time. Their debut studio album, Psychic, was released in 2013 and was followed up by Spiral, released in 2021 after a lengthy hiatus.

perplexity.description:
Nothing is the third studio album by Darkside, released in February 2025 via Matador Records. The album marks a significant creative departure for the electronic duo of Nicolás Jaar and Dave Harrington, as it represents their first full-length work since 2021's Spiral and their first as a trio following the addition of drummer and instrument designer Tlacael Esparza as a permanent member. Unlike their previous albums, which were constructed from pre-developed song fragments and scattered ideas, Nothing emerged from spontaneous jam sessions and improvisation, reflecting a fundamentally different compositional approach.

The nine-track album showcases Darkside's signature sound of intricate audio design and layered textures, featuring serpentine guitars, extraterrestrial static, distorted vocals, and cavernous drums arranged across tracks like "S.N.C," "Graucha Max," and the two-part "Hell Suite." The music balances haunted rhythms with uncanny beauty, creating what the label describes as "negative space, telepathic seance, and spectral improvisation." Standout single "S.N.C" exemplifies this aesthetic, with its six-minute runtime building to a groovy peak through layered clavs, vocals, and interjecting guitar lines that create a swirling tapestry of sound.

Nothing arrived as Darkside prepared for their first North American tour in 11 years, indicating renewed momentum for the group. The album's critical reception has positioned it as a notable entry in contemporary electronic music, demonstrating the band's continued evolution and the creative possibilities unlocked by their expanded lineup and jam-based compositional method.
